_comment: Optional per-model overrides keyed by GGUF file name without .gguf: {skip, id, family, languages: ['el','en'], extraArgs: [CLI args for every clip], langArgs: {el: [CLI args], en: [...]} (one process per language)}. Models are otherwise discovered from the GGUF headers under speech/audiocpp/models (quantized files only; folders starting with _ or . are ignored).

nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b-q6_k.notes: Nemotron needs an explicit ASR prompt language (el-GR / en-US).

cohere-transcribe-03-2026-q6_k.notes: Cohere defaults to English; pass the language per clip set.

moss-transcribe-diarize-q8_0.notes: Default prompt only: a plain-text --instruct made it hallucinate Vietnamese on an English clip. Output [start][S01]text[end] is stripped before scoring (stt-benchmark.js).
